note: Hand-written phrasings (PROTOCOL.md §2.3): per task shape, the canonical phrasing first and two fixed paraphrases. The generator fills the placeholders from the task's parameters; it never writes a phrasing of its own. {date_a}, {date_b} and {date_c} are three spellings of one date (9 March 2027; March 9, 2027; 2027-03-09). Every side receives the identical text (rule 4).

cheapest: Find me the cheapest flight from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a}.
What is the lowest fare WebAir has from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b}? Stops are fine.
Cheapest way to fly {origin} to {destination} on {date_c}, any number of stops.
nonstop: Find me a nonstop flight from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a}, the cheapest one.
I only want a direct flight from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b}. Which nonstop fare is cheapest?
Nonstop only, {origin} to {destination}, {date_c}: give me the lowest fare.
under: Find me a flight from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a} under ${max_price}.
Anything from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b} for less than {max_price} dollars? I want the cheapest.
{origin} to {destination} on {date_c}, at most ${max_price} per person, cheapest fare please.
business: One traveler from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a}, business class.
I'd like to fly business from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b}. What's the cheapest business fare?
Business cabin, {origin} to {destination}, {date_c}: the lowest fare.
bag: Find me the cheapest fare from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a} that includes a checked bag.
I need to check a suitcase. What is the cheapest fare from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b} with a checked bag included?
{origin} to {destination} on {date_c}: cheapest fare with one checked bag included.

change_fee: What is the change fee for the {family_name} fare on flight {flight_label} from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a}?
If I book {family_name} on {flight_label} from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b}, how much does it cost to change the ticket?
{flight_label}, {origin} to {destination}, {date_c}, {family_name} fare: what are the change rules and the fee?
refundable: Is the {family_name} fare on flight {flight_label} from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_a} refundable?
Can I get my money back if I cancel the {family_name} fare on {flight_label} from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b}?

quote: Please get me a booking quote for the {family_name} fare on {flight_label} from {origin_city} to {destination_city} on {date_b}, just for me.

buy: Yes, go ahead and buy it.
